name: error-envelope
description: Both remote commands answer with ePO's plain-text error envelope instead of a JSON document. Nothing decodes, so the run must report the error and finish with zero assets rather than aborting on json_decode, which has no exception handling in Starlark.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

log_contains: trellix-epo: failed to fetch the System Tree: Error 0: Access denied
